name: Supercharged Custom GPTs Guide ⚡️
description_md:
## What You Get 🚀
Here’s what’s included:

- 
Notion Guide- A step-by-step breakdown of the six methods to create and optimize your custom GPTs.

- 
Jack of All Trades Custom GPT Components- Fully detailed prompts and workflows for memory management, web scraping, Google Calendar automation, and PDF analysis.

- 
Memory Management System (mem0)- Manage user memories with commands for searching, adding, deleting, and retrieving data dynamically.

- 
Firecrawl Web Scraping API- Instructions and workflows for scraping websites and returning content in markdown or HTML formats.

- 
Google Calendar Automation- Automate event creation with attendee management, reminders, and Google Meet integration.

- 
Claude PDF Analysis API- Analyze complex PDFs and extract actionable insights using custom queries.

- 
Replit Links for Tools- Ready-to-use deployments for Firecrawl, mem0, and Claude PDF Analysis integrations.

- 
Slide Deck Featured in the Video- Detailed visuals to reinforce key concepts and workflows.

- 
Tool Links and Additional Resources- Direct links to Firecrawl, mem0, Make.com, and the Claude PDF API, with setup guides for seamless integration.

- 
Bonus Video Resource- Exclusive YouTube video tutorial on Claude PDF Analysis Integration for hands-on learning.

## If this is at all useful to you, would love if you could support the channel ❤️‍🔥
